create.candidateHelp: Commit SHA, image digest, or immutable artifact manifest reference.
create.configurationHelp: Versioned configuration and feature flag set.
create.contextHelp: Context is fixed when created. Scope and checks remain explicit and versioned.

readiness.approvedCurrent: Approved decision recorded for this revision.
readiness.notApprovedCurrent: No current approved decision for this revision.
readiness.awaitDecision: Required checks pass. Ready for the release owner's decision.
readiness.empty: No features included. Add the outcomes this candidate must support.
readiness.counts: {blockers, plural, one {# blocker} other {# blockers}} · {gaps, plural, one {# evidence gap} other {# evidence gaps}}
readiness.warningsCount: · {count, plural, one {# optional warning} other {# optional warnings}}

findings.definitionGap: {name} needs a required functional acceptance check.

overview.expired: Evidence expired; open the release review to recheck.

workspace.conflictHelp: Reload the release review before retrying if another person changed it.
workspace.missingCheck: The linked check is not part of the current release review. Choose a current check below.

check.subject: What this check verifies
check.claimHelp: State the expected behavior, e.g. Duplicate delivery creates one ledger entry.
check.environmentHelp: Evidence must match this environment and the release review context.
check.inactive: This check is no longer active.
check.scopeHelp: Feature, related components and release-wide checks
check.noMatches: No matching checks. Try another filter.
check.methodHelp: Describe how someone can verify this behavior.
check.purpose: Define what must work. Record the result after you verify it.

evidence.contextHelp: Record what you observed for this exact version and environment. Earlier results stay in the history.
evidence.localTime: Date and time in your local timezone.
evidence.linkHelp: Optional internal or external result URL. StateBoard does not fetch this link.
evidence.invalidTime: Enter a valid observation date and time.
evidence.empty: No evidence has been recorded for this check.
evidence.history: Evidence history · {count, plural, one {# observation} other {# observations}}
evidence.sourceSummary: {source} · A review reference is assigned when you save.
evidence.referenceHelp: Optional. Use an existing test run or review reference, or leave blank for this manual review.
evidence.observationHelp: Describe what happened and how you checked it.

decision.title: Release decision
decision.ownerHelp: A signed-in workspace owner records and publishes decisions.
decision.prepareHelp: Record a decision to prepare a public review.
decision.noLinks: No public links. Open a recorded decision to prepare one.
decision.revokeHelp: People with this link will lose access to its review and retained images.
decision.cannotApprove: This release review cannot be approved yet. You can record a held decision.
decision.label: Decision
decision.screens: Screens to retain in this review
decision.screensHelp: Selected screenshots are copied into the decision record so later replacement or deletion cannot alter this review.
decision.privateImagesHelp: Choose supporting images for this review. Previously reviewed images are included only when selected here.
decision.historicalHelp: The live release review has changed since this review. This decision is a historical record.
decision.expiredHelp: Recorded evidence has expired. Review the current release review before a new decision.
decision.counts: Required blockers: {blockers, number} · Evidence gaps: {gaps, number}

snapshot.oldLinksHelp: Feature links were not captured in this older review. Its saved annotations remain visible.

publication.help: Review the public copy and choose the images to share. Internal check details, evidence links, owners, and architecture are excluded from this share view.
publication.noImages: This decision has no retained images.

public.frozen: This is a saved review. It does not update as evidence changes or expires.
public.verificationHelp: Check verification at this review; availability requires deployment verification.

assets.title: Supporting review images
assets.privateHelp: Private until explicitly selected for a public review.
assets.label: Review image label

reasons.missing: No evidence matches the current candidate, environment, audience and check revision.
reasons.failedExpired: Verification failed; its evidence is also expired.
reasons.inconclusive: The latest verification could not establish this claim.
reasons.stale: The latest passing verification has expired.
reasons.noCapabilities: No features are included in this release review.
